title: Outside acceptance reruns as one script and three orphan-base drains end clean with zero lead turns
body:
Why: live outside acceptance t-s81vp3q (792f529) proved adopt and first-test PRs on orphan bases outside/{php,npm,py} of krn-works/krn, but no row was a clean zero-lead-turn drain (exits 73/74). Causes fixed since: ship ungated base and clean-status auto-merge (#879), Stop blocks only base-green standards and gap Proof uses `krn standards check --record` (9a01d0d, #880).
Outcome: rerun on fresh orphan bases from the scratch copies /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside/{php,npm,py}: adopt, then one unattended `krn lane run --ready` drain per base with zero lead turns, rows graded in .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt; the procedure is a committed script so the next rerun is one command; every new failure is a KRN defect fixed with a regression test; branches deleted afterwards.
Proof: three rows with drain exit 0 and every PR merged; `node --test test/scripts/outside-acceptance.test.ts` for the script's argument and cleanup logic.
